abstract: A case of sacrococcygeal teratoma with unusually high intraspinal extension is reported and the symptomatology and treatment are discussed. A 7-month-old male presented at birth with a prominent mass of the right gluteal region preventing him from straightening his legs and causing undue effort during defecation. Magnetic resonance T1-weighted imaging revealed a thoracolumbosacrococcygeal, partly cystic tumor with intraspinal extension up to the mid-thoracic spine. During two-staged surgery, a cystic tumor containing fragments of hair, teeth, and bone and adherent to its surroundings was completely removed. The histologic examination confirmed the presence of a benign teratoma. A neurogenic bladder of the lower-motor-neuron type and constipation improved spontaneously. No further neurological deficits before and during a 3-year postoperative follow-up period were recorded.
abstract_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫で脊柱管内へ異常に高度に進展した症例を報告し、症状と治療について考察する。生後7か月の男児が出生時に右臀部の目立つ腫瘤を呈し、両脚を伸ばすことができず、排便時に過度の努力を要していた。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)のT1強調画像で、胸腰仙尾部にわたる一部嚢胞性の腫瘍が、中部胸椎まで脊柱管内に進展していることが示された。2期的手術により、毛髪、歯、骨の断片を含む嚢胞性腫瘍を、周囲への癒着を伴っていたが完全に摘出した。病理組織学により良性奇形腫と確認された。神経因性膀胱(下位運動ニューロン型)と便秘は自然に改善した。術後3年間のフォローアップでも、新たな神経学的欠損は記録されなかった。
